summary:
The telemetry Host clears FsggCoherentSetVersion and embeds its Dashboard/runtime closure. A newer Coord.Cli/Kit/Drivers coherent-set publication therefore does not deliver later Host/dashboard features. Host0.8 is the independent artifact bound to74cbd6f0b1b598d48556eb854c4ba6a3c3abda54 ([original publisher](https://github.com/FS-GG/.github/actions/runs/39580298871)). Check the selected package manifest, payload and source against the required receiver feature; source tests and synthetic package/browser controls establish their own scopes.

Prospective candidate qualification requires coordinate absence. An already published version needs a separate read-only observation. A local org-package403 establishes that caller's capability gap; it does not establish package absence or authorize rebuild, republish, journal reset or publisher replay. [PR4787](https://github.com/FS-GG/.github/pull/4787), source8963282fbae23e692df2d2eaae1bab3e84e99306, adds a closed Host0.8 observation choice to the existing feed-readiness workflow using its unchanged read-only repository token permissions. This can obtain the missing org archive when that hosted credential has access;403 still refuses.

The workflow source and published artifact source are separate identities. The observer pins the74cb verifier and dependency closure, immutable tag/release, manifest and public journal, then checks the bounded org archive against the journal archive digest and producer payload. Fixed request identities, absolute deadlines, credential stripping on redirects and no automatic download retry retain the read-only boundary. Final native checks preserve immutable identities/content while treating download counters as observations. The workflow retains the exact successful observation artifact; it does not invoke publication or install/start the Host.

The [hosted observation](https://github.com/FS-GG/.github/actions/runs/39591087147) supplied the raw org package for independent verification. In this0.8 case, both feed archive rows match the original publication journal and common producer payload, closing the dependent journal/promote assertions in the scoped eight-effect publication assessment. The original partial readback remains unchanged; no publisher replay established this result. Workflow success alone would not suffice.

This publication acceptance does not accept the installed journey. Home’s existing application custodian still supplies the exact receiver/artifact/configuration/store tuple and operation authority. The4705 genuine canonical receipt, actual sanitized projection/browser behavior, interruption/recovery and later calibrated adoption retain their separate owners and acceptance. Hosted package access grants no installation permission and does not close Delivery4707 or its parent.
title: Independent Host publication and hosted package reads preserve separate acceptance boundaries
